provenance.method: Extracted tarball to /tmp/opencode/itsaplan-logs (original untouched) and parsed all six container 0.log files programmatically (Python): CRI prefix stripping, keyword scan for task fields, JSON/SSE body extraction, UUID/endpoint enumeration, and full-text scan for human-readable task tokens.

key_finding: The saved logs are POST-wipe startup logs from the freshly recreated empty database, not pre-wipe logs. They contain no task data. The API log begins with 'Running migrations...' then 'Migrations applied'; the only recurring content is '[planner] ... APIError: Invalid API key' and agent/chat claim failures (HTTP 500/502).

api_model_discovered.mcp_transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST; responses are text/event-stream (SSE, 'data: {...}')
api_model_discovered.reference: scripts/itsaplan_sync.py implements the full idempotent create flow (fingerprint in title, search-before-create)

recreation.reason: No records recovered, so there is nothing to recreate. No writes were made to the Itsaplan DB or API.

blockers: Zero task records exist in the saved logs: they are post-wipe logs from the new empty DB.
No MCP_ITSAPLAN_API_KEY is present in the cluster namespace (itsaplan secrets checked) or in this repo; the security-scan sync runs externally (Hermes).
All project / board-column / issue-type / user IDs were destroyed with the database; no IDs remain to target even if records were recovered.

The live app is unhealthy: itsaplan-andrzej-runner gets HTTP 500 from /agent-runs/claim and /agent-chats/claim, and the API logs '[planner] APIError: Invalid API key', so an API-based recreation would currently fail regardless.
